assertions.subject: Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease
assertions.quote: The sporadic form of CJD is the most common prion disorder in humans

assertions.subject: Sporadic CJD
assertions.quote: The sporadic form of CJD is the most common prion disorder in humans

assertions.subject: Sporadic CJD
assertions.quote: Sporadic CJD (sCJD) accounts for ~85% of all cases of human PrP prion disease

assertions.subject: Inherited prion diseases
assertions.quote: inherited prion diseases account for 10–15% of all cases

assertions.subject: Infectious PrP prion diseases
assertions.quote: infectious PrP prion diseases account for <1% of all cases

assertions.subject: Familial CJD
assertions.quote: Familial CJD (fCJD), GerstmannSträussler-Scheinker (GSS) disease, and fatal familial insomnia (FFI) are all dominantly inherited prion diseases

assertions.subject: Gerstmann-Sträussler-Scheinker disease
assertions.quote: Familial CJD (fCJD), GerstmannSträussler-Scheinker (GSS) disease, and fatal familial insomnia (FFI) are all dominantly inherited prion diseases

assertions.subject: Fatal familial insomnia
assertions.quote: Familial CJD (fCJD), GerstmannSträussler-Scheinker (GSS) disease, and fatal familial insomnia (FFI) are all dominantly inherited prion diseases

assertions.subject: Kuru
assertions.quote: Kuru of the Fore people of New Guinea is thought to have resulted from the consumption of brains from dead relatives during ritualistic cannibalism

assertions.subject: Iatrogenic CJD
assertions.predicate: accidental inoculation of patients with prions
assertions.quote: Iatrogenic CJD (iCJD) seems to be the result of the accidental inoculation of patients with prions

assertions.subject: Variant CJD
assertions.quote: Variant CJD (vCJD) in teenagers and young adults in Europe is the result of exposure to tainted beef from cattle with bovine spongiform encephalopathy (BSE)
